ideas.source_anchor: Madara reflects the Rinne Sharingan across the moon so one cast of Infinite Tsukuyomi reaches nearly everyone on Earth at once.
caption_lines: THE MOON WAS THE ‘DEPLOY TO ALL’ BUTTON.
